title_sq: SHITET VILË NË GREEN UP LIVING – MJULL BATHORE
description_sq:
Green Up Living i vendosur në një nga zonat më të gjelbëruara dhe elitare të Tiranës – Mjull Bathore. Vila moderne 2-katëshe me një kat nëntokë ofron një mënyrë jetese të qetë, të pastër dhe të paprekur nga urbanizimi i dendur. Akseset e shpejta me rrugët kryesore e lidhin kompleksin me qendrën e Tiranës në pak minuta, ndërsa komuniteti i organizuar dhe privatësia e lartë e bëjnë këtë vend ideal për jetesë familjare të standardit të lartë.

title_en: VILLA FOR SALE IN GREEN UP LIVING - MJUL BATHORE
description_en: Green Up Living located in one of the greenest and elite areas of Tirana - Mjull Bathore. The modern 2-storey villa with a basement offers a quiet, clean lifestyle untouched by dense urbanisation. Quick access to the main roads connect the complex to the center of Tirana in a few minutes, while the organized community and high privacy make this an ideal place for high-standard family living. DESCRIPTION OF THE VILLA Floor -1 • Construction area: 248 m² • 2 underground parking spaces • 3 storage rooms for storage, laundry or technical room • 1 toilet • Internal access through stairs connected to the upper floors Floor 0 (Ground) • Construction area: 112 m² • Spacious living room: living room + kitchen with direct access to the veranda • 1 day toilet • Veranda relaxing area and private garden • Dedicated swimming pool within the plot of the villa • Maximum natural light and direct access to the outdoors Floor 1 (Sleeping area) • Construction area: 140 m² • 3 comfortable bedrooms • Master bedroom with private toilet and wardrobe • 2 toilets in total on the first floor • Green terrace – area for private relaxation in the fresh air • Staircase and corridor with natural lighting Contact us for more information and to arrange a site visit!
